steps.title: Summarize Category
steps.change: Each distinct Active value is one category branch row, including NULL. The two active categories share one group.
steps.added_sql:
SELECT 'Category' AS source_table,
       'Active' AS flag_column, CAST(Active AS TEXT) AS raw_value , count(*) as row_count
from Category
Group by Active

steps.title: Summarize Payments
steps.change: This independent branch counts each Allowed value in Payments. N occurs twice and Y once.
steps.added_sql:
SELECT 'Payments' AS source_table,
       'Allowed' AS flag_column,
CAST(Allowed AS TEXT) AS raw_value , count(*) as row_count
from Payments
group by Allowed
